cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station lounge bar — seated on a chair; a quiet coastal saltwater lido at dawn beside a low diving platform — she peels away a translucent protective sun-film from her upper arm after resting by the pool; an indoor skydiving wind tunnel lobby with a broad curved observation window — she relaxes after a flight session; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a cable car cabin over a misty valley — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — holds a white feather fan in both hands in front of her chest; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — perched on a ledge or edge; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a rocky waterfall pool under green trees — chest-deep in the water; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds a small hand lantern low at her side
